string.text: I see your condition... May I ask: who is the father of your unborn child?
How can you ask such a thing, {PLAYER.NAME}? This child is yours! Have you already forgotten our nights of passion?
(She lowers her eyes tearfully) Forgive me, {PLAYER.NAME}... I have sinned. The true father is {FATHER_NAME}. Please have mercy and keep this secret!
(She looks around anxiously and whispers) Not a word to anyone, {PLAYER.NAME}! My husband thinks the child is his, but the true father is {FATHER_NAME}... I trust in your discretion.

(She glances around nervously and lowers her voice) Please, not a word to anyone, {PLAYER.NAME}... This child is from {FATHER_NAME}. There was a secret bond between us... I hope I can count on your honor and silence.
What insolence! My personal life is not a matter for idle gossip. Do not pry into what does not concern you, {PLAYER.NAME}!
How is your pregnancy progressing? Is everything well?
Thank you for your care, my love. Both the child and I are doing well. I can hardly wait for our little one to arrive!
Thank you for your concern, {PLAYER.NAME}. Both the child and I are doing well. {FATHER_NAME} has been very attentive and caring.
Thank you for your concern, {PLAYER.NAME}. Both the child and I are doing well. And thank you for keeping mine and {FATHER_NAME}'s secret.
Secret revealed: {MOTHER_NAME} is carrying your child!
Secret revealed: the father of {MOTHER_NAME}'s child is {FATHER_NAME}!
